title: Profiling Python Applications
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of profiling python applications.

content.intro: This lesson introduces profiling python applications as part of python performance and internals. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Measure before optimizing. Use representative inputs, repeat benchmarks carefully, and preserve correctness while changing data structures or caching behavior.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Profiling measures where program time or memory is spent before optimization.
